name: Optimizing train operational plan in an urban rail corridor based on the maximum headway function
description: Mined from Optimizing train operational plan in an urban rail corridor based on the maximum headway function (Transportation Research Part C Emerging Technologies, 2016).

provenance.reference: Optimizing train operational plan in an urban rail corridor based on the maximum headway function
provenance.author: Feng Shi; Shuo Zhao; Zhou Zhao; Pu Wang; Michael G.H. Bell

indices.name: s
indices.description: Station index in the set S.

indices.name: S
indices.description: Set of stations on the corridor.

indices.name: I
indices.description: index set for i from 1 to n

indices.name: J
indices.description: index set for j from 1 to n

indices.name: I_after
indices.description: index set for i from C^B+1 to n

parameters.name: F
parameters.description: Maximum headway function for direction D or U.

parameters.name: n
parameters.description: Number of train trips in each direction.

parameters.name: C
parameters.description: Parking capacity at terminal (C^A or C^B).

parameters.name: constraints
parameters.description: Set of constraints (7)-(16) in model M1.

parameters.name: M_hat
parameters.description: Set of feasible train-trip pair connections at terminal with yard.

parameters.name: M
parameters.description: Assignment of up-direction to down-direction train trips.

parameters.name: C_A
parameters.description: Maximum number of trains that can be simultaneously in service on the corridor.

parameters.name: C_B
parameters.description: Number of trains based at the terminal with a yard.

parameters.name: F_D
parameters.description: Maximum headway function for down-direction departures.

parameters.name: F_U
parameters.description: Maximum headway function for up-direction departures.

parameters.name: sigma
parameters.description: Binary indicator whether a train stops at station s_k.

parameters.name: t_D
parameters.description: Down-direction departure time window bounds (L = latest start, E = earliest end).

parameters.name: t_U
parameters.description: Up-direction departure time window bounds (L = latest start, E = earliest end).

parameters.name: tau_A
parameters.description: Minimum turnaround time at the terminal without a yard.

parameters.name: tau_B
parameters.description: Minimum turnaround time at the terminal with a yard.

parameters.name: tau_min
parameters.description: Minimum required headway between consecutive train trips.

variables.name: x
variables.description: Departure time of down-direction train trip i.

variables.name: y
variables.description: Departure time of up-direction train trip j.

variables.name: Z
variables.description: Objective value representing total number of train trips.

variables.name: w
variables.description: Number of trains parking at terminal s_A at time t.

constraints.name: eq_0004
constraints.description: Definition of maximum headway function F_D(x_i) during off-peak hours.

constraints.name: eq_0011
constraints.description: Latest acceptable departure time of the first up-direction train trip.

constraints.name: eq_0012
constraints.description: Earliest acceptable departure time of the last down-direction train trip.

objective.name: objective
objective.description: Minimize the number of train trips 2n in the train departure profile model (M1).
